t: Men's Durango Maverick XP Square Toe Waterproof Lacer Work Boots (DDB0238)
d:
Details 
 This is the men's 8 Russet Waterproof Durango® Maverick XP™ Lacer.
 This style is full-grain leather with a soft mesh lining and Durango® Waterproof membrane bootie to keep your feet dry all day long. It has a removable brush guard kiltie and the Durango X-Treme Comfort footbed with Memory Foam for all day comfort and support.
 Inside it has a fiberglass shank for lightweight stability, dual-density midsole with firmer shock absorbing heel for added stability and a soft shock absorbing forepart for ultimate flexibility and comfort. The rolled shank area and anti-torsion ridged external shank provides added lateral stability and the outsole is a multi-durometer rubber with high abrasion outer lugs for high impact durability and softer durometer mid lugs for added flexibility and increased slip and oil resistance. It has a double row sole stitch around the square toe for added durability and a 1 ½ rocker heel.
- Removable brush guard kiltie
- Waterproof membrane
- Square toe
- Full-grain leather
- Rolled shank area
- 1 1/2" Rocker heel
- Fiberglass shank
- Soft mesh lining
- Double row sole stitch
- Dual-Density Midsole with firmer shock absorbing heel for added stability and a soft shock absorbing forepart for ultimate flexibility and comfort
- Anti-torsion rigid external shank provides added lateral stability
- Multi-Durometer Rubber Outsole with high abrasion rubber outer lugs for high-impact durability and softer durometer mid lugs for added flexibility and increased slip, oil and heat resistance
